text.en:
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Territory of Putrajaya (Extension

and Modification of Islamic Family Law (Federal Territory) Act 1984)

Order 2002.

(2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 1 February 2001.

Extension of the Islamic Family Law (Federal Territory) Act 1984 and

subsidiary legislation made under it
text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya

(Pemerluasan dan Ubah Suaian Akta Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam

(Wilayah Persekutuan) 1984) 2002.

(2) Perintah ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Februari 2001.

Pemerluasan Akta Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam (Wilayah Persekutuan)

1984 dan perundangan subsidiari yang dibuat di bawahnya

text.en:
2. (1) The Islamic Family Law (Federal Territory) Act 1984 [Act 303], which

is referred to as the "extended Act" in this Order and the subsidiary legislation

made under it are extended to the Federal Territory of Putrajaya.

(2) Subsidiary legislation made under the extended Act shall have effect

with such modifications as may be necessary to bring the subsidiary legislation

into accord with the provisions of the extended Act as modified by this Order.

Modification of subsection 1(1) of extended Act
text.ms:
2. (1) Akta Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam (Wilayah Persekutuan) 1984

[Akta 303], yang disebut "Akta yang diperluas" dalam Perintah ini dan perundangan

subsidiari yang dibuat di bawahnya, diperluas ke Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya.

(2) Perundangan subsidiari yang dibuat di bawah Akta yang diperluas hendaklah

berkuat kuasa dengan ubah suaian sebagaimana yang perlu untuk menyelaraskan

perundangan subsidiari itu dengan peruntukan Akta itu sebagaimana yang

diubahsuaikan oleh Perintah ini.
P.U. (A) 247. 2382

Ubah suaian subseksyen 1(1) Akta yang diperluas

text.en:
3. The extended Act is modified in subsection 1(1) by substituting for the

words "Kuala Lumpur and Labuan" the words "Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya and

Labuan".

Modification of section 2 of extended Act
text.ms:
3. Akta yang diperluas diubahsuaikan dalam subseksyen 1(1) dengan

menggantikan perkataan "Kuala Lumpur dan Labuan" dengan perkataan "Kuala

Lumpur, Putrajaya dan Labuan".

Ubah suaian seksyen 2 Akta yang diperluas

text.en:
4. Section 2 of the extended Act is modified—

(a) in the definition of "Administration Enactment"—

(i) in paragraph (a), by deleting the word "and" after the semicolon;

(ii) in paragraph (b), by inserting the word "and" after the semicolon;

and

(iii) by inserting after paragraph (b) the following paragraph:

"(c) in relation to the Federal Territory of Purtajaya,

as modified and extended by the Federal

Territory of Putrajaya (Extension and

Modification of the Islamic Family Law

(Federal Territory) Act 1984) Order 2002 made

pursuant to section 7 of the Constitution

Akta A1095. (Amendment) Act 2001;";

P.U. (A) 247/2002.

(b) in the definition of "Federal Territory", by substituting for the words

"Kuala Lumpur or Labuan" the words "Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya or

Labuan";

(c) in the definition of "Federal Territories", by substituting for the words

"Kuala Lumpur and Labuan" the words "Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya

and Labuan".

Cessation of application of the Enactment and transitional
text.ms:
4. Seksyen 2 Akta yang diperluas diubahsuaikan—

(a) dalam takrif "Enakmen Pentadbiran"—

(i) dalam perenggan (a), dengan memotong perkataan "dan" selepas

koma bertitik;

(ii) dalam perenggan (b), dengan memasukkan perkataan "dan"

selepas koma bertitik; dan

(iii) dengan memasukkan selepas perenggan (b) perenggan yang

berikut:

"(c) berhubung dengan Wilayah Persekutuan

Putrajaya, sebagaimana yang diperluas dan

diubahsuaikan oleh Perintah Wilayah

Persekutuan Putrajaya (Pemerluasan dan Ubah

Suaian Akta Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam

(Wilayah Persekutuan) 1984) 2002 yang dibuat

menurut seksyen 7 Akta Perlembagaan

(Pindaan) 2001;";

(b) dalam takrif "Wilayah Persekutuan", dengan menggantikan perkataan

"Kuala Lumpur atau Labuan" dengan perkataan "Kuala Lumpur,

Putrajaya atau Labuan";

(c) dalam takrif "Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan", dengan menggantikan

perkataan "Kuala Lumpur dan Labuan" dengan perkataan "Kuala

Lumpur, Putrajaya dan Labuan".

Pemberhentian pemakaian Enakmen dan peralihan

text.en:
5. (1) The Islamic Family Law Enactment 1984 [Sel. En. 4/1984] ceases to

apply to Federal Territory of Putrajaya.

(2) Any proceedings under the Islamic Family Law Enactment 1984

[Sel. En. 4/1984] pending before any court immediately before the coming into

force of this Order shall be continued and concluded under that Enactment and

for the purpose of such proceedings this Order shall be treated as if it had not

been made.

Made 21 May 2002

[JAWI/A/145; PN(PU2)609/II]

By Command

TAN SRI SAMSUDIN BIN OSMAN

Secretary to the Cabinet

P.U. (A) 248.

AKTA PERLEMBAGAAN (PINDAAN) 2001

PERINTAH WILAYAH PERSEKUTUAN PUTRAJAYA (PEMERLUASAN DAN

UBAH SUAIAN AKTA PROSEDUR JENAYAH SYARIAH

(WILAYAH-WILAYAH PERSEKUTUAN) 1997) 2002

PADA menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh seksyen 7 Akta Perlembagaan

(Pindaan) 2001 [Akta A1095], Yang di-Pertuan Agong membuat perintah yang

berikut:

Nama dan permulaan kuat kuasa

1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya

(Pemerluasan dan Ubah Suaian Akta Prosedur Jenayah Syariah (WilayahWilayah Persekutuan) 1997) 2002.

(2) Perintah ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Februari 2001.

Pemerluasan Akta

2. Akta Prosedur Jenayah Syariah (Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan) 1997

[Akta 560], yang disebut "Akta yang diperluas" dalam Perintah ini, diperluas

ke Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya.

P.U. (A) 247-248.

Ubah suaian subseksyen 1(1) Akta yang diperluas

3. Akta yang diperluas diubahsuaikan dalam subseksyen 1(1) dengan

menggantikan perkataan "Kuala Lumpur dan Labuan" dengan perkataan "Kuala

Lumpur, Putrajaya dan Labuan".

Ubah suaian seksyen 2 Akta yang diperluas

4. Seksyen 2 Akta yang diperluas diubahsuaikan—

(a) dalam takrif "Enakmen"—

(i) dalam perenggan (a), dengan memotong perkataan "dan" selepas

koma bertitik;

(ii) dalam perenggan (b), dengan memasukkan perkataan "dan"

selepaas koma bertitik; dan

(iii) dengan memasukkan selepas perenggan (b) perenggan yang

berikut:

"(c) berhubung dengan Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya,

sebagaimana yang diperluas dan diubahsuaikan oleh

Perintah Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya (Pemerluasan

dan Ubah Suaian Akta Prosedur Jenayah Syariah

(Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan) 1997) 2002 [P.U. (A)

248/2002] yang dibuat menurut seksyen 7 Akta

Perlembagaan (Pindaan) 2001 [Akta A1095];";

(b) dalam takrif "Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan" dengan menggantikan

perkataan "Kuala Lumpur dan Labuan" dengan perkataan "Kuala

Lumpur, Putrajaya dan Labuan".

Pemerhentian pemakaian Enakmen dan peralihan
text.ms:
5. (1) Enakmen Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam 1984 [Sel. En. 4/1984] hendaklah

terhenti terpakai bagi Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya.

(2) Mana-mana prosiding di bawah Enakmen Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam

1984 [Sel. En. 4/1984] yang wujud di hadapan mana-mana mahkamah sebaik

sebelum Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa hendaklah diteruskan dan diselesaikan

di bawah Enakmen itu dan bagi maksud prosiding itu Perintah ini hendaklah

dianggap seolah-olah tidak dibuat.

Dibuat 21 Mei 2002

[JAWI/A/145; PN(PU2

)609/II]

CONSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) ACT 2001

FEDERAL TERRITORY OF PUTRAJAYA (EXTENSION AND

MODIFICATION OF SYARIAH CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (FEDERAL

TERRITORIES) ACT 1997) ORDER 2002

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 7 of the Constitution (Amendment)

Act 2001 [Act A1095], the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Territory of Putrajaya (Extension

and Modification of Syariah Criminal Procedure (Federal Territories) Act

1997) Order 2002.

(2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 1 February 2001.

Extension of Act

2. The Syariah Criminal Procedure (Federal Territories) Act 1997 [Act 560],

which is referred to as the "extended Act" in this Order, is extended to the

Federal Territory of Putrajaya.

Modification of subsection 1(1) of extended Act

3. The extended Act is modified in subsection 1(1) by substituting for the

words "Kuala Lumpur and Labuan" the words "Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya and

Labuan".

Modification of section 2 of extended Act

4. Section 2 of the extended Act is modified—

(a) in the definition of "Enactment"—

(i) in paragraph (a), by deleting the word "and" after the semicolon;

(ii) in paragraph (b), by inserting the word "and" after the semicolon;

and

(iii) by inserting after paragraph (b) the following paragraph:

"(c) in relation to the Federal Territory of Putrajaya, as

modified and extended by the Federal Territory of

Putrajaya (Extension and Modification of Syariah Criminal

Procedure (Federal Territories) Act 1997) Order 2002

[P.U. (A) 248/2002] made pursuant to section 7 of the

Constitution (Amendment) Act 2001 [Act A1095];";

(b) in the definition of "Federal Territories", by substituting for the words

"Kuala Lumpur and Labuan" the words "Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya

and Labuan".

P.U. (A) 248.

Cessation of application of the Enactment and transitional

5. (1) The Syariah Criminal Procedure Code Enactment 1991 [Sel. En. 6/1991]

ceases to apply to Federal Territory of Putrajaya.

(2) Any proceedings under the Syariah Criminal Procedure Code Enactment

1991 [Sel. En. 6/1991] pending in any court immediately before the coming into

force of this Order shall be continued and concluded under that Enactment and

for the purpose of such proceedings this Order shall be treated as if it had not

been made.

Made 21 May 2002

[JAWI/A/145; PN(PU2)609/II]

By Command

TAN SRI SAMSUDIN BIN OSMAN

Secretary to the Cabinet

P.U. (A) 249.

2. (1) The Administration of Islamic Law (Federal Territories) Act 1993

[Act 505], which is referred to as the "extended Act" in this Order and the

subsidiary legislation made under it, are extended to the Federal Territory of

Putrajaya.

(2) Subsidiary legislation made under the extended Act shall have effect

with such modifications as may be necessary to bring the legislation into accord

with the provisions of the extended Act as modified by this Order.

Modification of subsection 1(1) of the extended Act

3. The extended Act is modified in subsection 1(1) by substituting for the

words "Kuala Lumpur and Labuan" the words "Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya and

Labuan".

Modification of section 2 of the extended Act

(a) in the definition of "Enactment",—

(ii) in paragraph (b), by inserting the word "and" after the semicolon;

and

(iii) by inserting after paragraph (b), the following paragraph:

"(c) in relation to the Federal Territory of Putrajaya, as

modified and extended by the Federal Territory of

Putrajaya (Extension and Modification of Administration

of Islamic Law (Federal Territories) Act 1993) 2002

[P.U. (A) 250/2002] made pursuant to section 7 of the

Constitution (Amendment) Act 2001 [Act A1095];";

(b) in the definition of "Federal Territories", by substituting for the words

Made 21 May 2002

[JAWI/A/145; PN(PU2

)609/II]

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 7 of the Constitution (Amendment)

Act 2001 [Act A1095], the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

and Modification of Syariah Criminal Offences (Federal Territories)

(ii) in paragraph (b), by inserting the word "and" after the semicolon;

and

and extended by the Federal Territory of Putrajaya

(Extension and Modification of Syariah Criminal Offences
